record.original_question: Let C_f: W^p - W = f(X) in k[X] be a p-cyclic cover of the affine line over an algebraically closed field k of characteristic p > 0. Given an extension of Z/pZ by an elementary abelian p-group (Z/pZ)^n that can occur as a p-Sylow subgroup of Aut(C_f), is it possible to choose f(X) in F_p[X] so that C_f realizes that extension, with the kernel Z/pZ equal to the Artin-Schreier covering group defined by C_f?

evidence.quote: Let C_f : W^p - W = f(X) in k[X] be a p-cyclic cover of the affine line over k.
Question 6.1 For a given group extension as above is it possible to find f(X) in F_p[X] such that C_f realizes this extension?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field of characteristic $p>0$, and let $\mathbb{F}_p\subset k$ be the prime field. For a polynomial $f(X)\in k[X]$, consider the smooth affine curve
$$C_f:\quad W^p-W=f(X)\subset\mathbb{A}^2_k,$$
a $p$-cyclic (Artin–Schreier) cover of the affine line. Let $\mathrm{Aut}(C_f)$ denote the automorphism group of the smooth projective model of $C_f$ over $k$, and let $G_f\subset\mathrm{Aut}(C_f)$ be a $p$-Sylow subgroup. The cover comes equipped with a canonical Artin–Schreier covering group $\mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z}\hookrightarrow\mathrm{Aut}(C_f)$ generated by $(X,W)\mapsto(X,W+1)$, which lies in $G_f$ and is normal there, giving rise to a central extension
$$1\longrightarrow \mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z}\longrightarrow G_f\longrightarrow (\mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z})^n\longrightarrow 1$$
for some $n\geq 0$.

Question: Given any group extension
$$1\longrightarrow \mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z}\longrightarrow E\longrightarrow (\mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z})^n\longrightarrow 1$$
that arises in this way as the $p$-Sylow subgroup of $\mathrm{Aut}(C_f)$ for some $f(X)\in k[X]$, does there exist a polynomial $f(X)\in\mathbb{F}_p[X]$ such that the corresponding cover $C_f$ realizes the given extension, with the distinguished kernel $\mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z}$ identified with the Artin–Schreier covering group of $C_f$?
artifact.status_search_result: The question appears in work of Lehr and Matignon on automorphism groups of $p$-cyclic covers of the affine line, classifying $p$-Sylow subgroups as central extensions of $\mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z}$ by an elementary abelian $p$-group. Searches did not turn up a definitive resolution of whether every such extension can be realized over $\mathbb{F}_p$; subsequent literature treats related cases (e.g. extraspecial subgroups, specific families) but no clear general answer was located.

status_evidence.snippet: p-Sylow subgroups are extensions of a p-cyclic group by an elementary abelian p-group
status_evidence.claim: Establishes the structure of p-Sylow subgroups, providing the context of the realization question.
